description: S458 slice 2 (gap g-refinement-union-member-unchecked-s458): a union with a refined member is judged — the value must satisfy one member. `show(v: number(>0) | string)` called with -4 matches neither `number(>0)` nor `string`, so the entry check throws E-CONTRACT-001-RT and @shown keeps "none". Before, a refinement inside a union other than `T | not` was not checked at all.
rationale: §53.3.1: the refinement narrows its base type and is evaluated at every binding site; a union member that is a refinement keeps that meaning (a value inhabits the union by inhabiting a member).
